story_threads: Ontario Budget 2026 commits $210B ten-year capital plan ($37B in 2026-27), with $64B over ten years for health infrastructure including ~50 hospital projects and ~3,000 new beds.

Unemployment held at 7.6% in March, unchanged m/m. Q4 2025 employment +58,900 (+0.7%), first strong quarter after two weak quarters.
Ring of Fire road construction targeted for June 2026, roads opening November 2030 -- five years ahead of prior timeline.

cross_references.interpretation: Held at 7.6% despite Q4 gains; effective tariff rate on ON exports to U.S. exceeds 6%.
Negative YoY CPI, contrasting with national +1.8%.
